name: The Destruction of Karpenisi
summary:
The Destruction of Karpenisi – The Chronicle of a Disaster in Virtual Reality

Karpenisi, built amphitheatrically at the foot of Mount Velouchi, was for centuries the human and cultural center of mountainous Evrytania. In August 1944, however, its fate was sealed in the most violent way. The virtual reality application "The Destruction of Karpenisi" recreates those dark days with absolute fidelity, offering the viewer an experience that goes beyond mere narrative and becomes experiential learning.
